name: Veldtmann Pressline Night Shift Full Kit
description: A head-to-toe pressline night crew uniform built for twelve-hour shifts under fluorescent factory light. The core piece is a charcoal-grey ripstop coverall with Veldtmann's orange chevron stripe running diagonally across the chest and left shoulder, embroidered name patch above the right breast pocket, and a corponation logo stamped in heat-transfer vinyl on the back yoke. The coverall features reinforced knee panels in a darker charcoal, triple-stitched seams throughout, and a side-zip aug channel running from the left hip to the mid-calf to accommodate chrome leg prosthetics or exo-brace struts. Underneath sits a Veldtmann-branded moisture-wicking thermal undershirt in slate grey, crew-neck, with flatlock seams to prevent friction burns during long wear. A low-profile hard hat in safety orange clips to a belt loop when not in use. Hands are covered by cut-resistant synth-leather gloves with the fingertips of the dominant hand left open for BCI touchpad operation.
functionality: aug-channel side zip for chrome leg accommodation, reinforced knee panels, BCI-open fingertip gloves, tool loops at hip and thigh, chest and hip pockets with magnetic closures, hard hat clip loop, moisture-wicking underlayer
what_it_says: This is someone who shows up, clocks in, and does the work. The name patch and corponation branding say they belong to a machine — not proudly, not bitterly, just practically. The immaculate condition of the coverall despite its age signals discipline and a certain quiet dignity.
story_hooks: A worker's name patch belongs to someone who died on the floor three months ago — and they're still wearing it because no one updated the system.
The aug-channel zip conceals a smuggled data chip sewn into the lining, passed between shifts by workers organizing against Veldtmann's new productivity quotas.
A supervisor notices the corponation logo has been subtly defaced on a worker's back yoke — a small act of resistance that could mean termination or worse.
